LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)

   D. went

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)

   C. Only one word repeated

2. D — went

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel from the rest of the world - Them.

12. A — run

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Non-Fiction: Blogs - Definition - Features - Functions - Essential elements; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
